# Black Myth | #DungeonKing

## “Lone Against the Darkness, Become an Immortal Myth”

**Black Myth** is a legendary guild that consists of only one extraordinary warrior figure, **DungeonKing** who is known as a terrifying shadow in the world of **IdleMMO**. The guild is surrounded by mystery and myth, as few really know the true power of **DungeonKing**. He is a warrior who has conquered the strongest dungeons single-handedly, with abilities and powers beyond imagination. **Black Myth** is not just a guild, but a living legend of a warrior who transcends normal human limitations.
